faq.q: How much does The Law Offices of Bruce S. Meth charge?
faq.a: The Law Offices of Bruce S. Meth publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does The Law Offices of Bruce S. Meth offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. The Law Offices of Bruce S. Meth publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does The Law Offices of Bruce S. Meth have offices?
faq.a: The Law Offices of Bruce S. Meth publishes two offices, in Chula Vista and San Diego. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at The Law Offices of Bruce S. Meth?
faq.a: The Law Offices of Bruce S. Meth names one attorney on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: California does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results The Law Offices of Bruce S. Meth publishes verified?
faq.a: No. The Law Offices of Bruce S. Meth publishes 21 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.
